objectives:
In the course, students will expect to:

	Develop a basic understanding of the formations of Englishness in the early periods.

	Examine the literary texts via the lens of cultural, religious, and political successions.

	Cultivate the basic skill set for literary and cultural studies via in-class activities and take-home assignment.
content:
*Important Note: This is a required course for the sophomore year. Should you need the passcode, you MUST attend the first class.本課程為英文系大二必選修課程，如欲索取密碼卡加選本課同學(含本系及外系)，必須參加開學第一堂課，並於第一堂課結束後與授課教師談話。有修習教程或者轉學生有優先選課排序。無出席第一堂課，即失去加選資格。

In this course we will read a cluster of key texts that shape the contour of the English literary canon against the backdrop of the rise of the British Empire in the early periods (up to the end of the 17th century). We will cover some of the most prominent literary genres informed by the linguistic transformation from Middle English to Early Modern English, such as frame narrative, romance, fabliau, drama, sonnet, and metaphysical poetry. By reading these texts, students are expected to not only gain a more diverse, comprehensive understanding of the changing nature of “Englishness,” but also develop a critical sense of individual texts pertaining to their historical backgrounds and contexts.

本課程將閱讀一系列影響英國早期文學正典形成的重要文本，並將其置於大英帝國初期興起的歷史背景下加以探討。我們將涵蓋十四至十七世紀間許多重要的文學體裁--包括框架敘事、羅曼史、諷刺寓言詩、戲劇、十四行詩與形而上詩--並閱讀從喬叟到莎士比亞等經典作家的代表作品。透過閱讀這些文本，學生不僅能更全面且多元地理解「英國性」隨時代變遷的樣貌，也將學習如何批判性地閱讀文本與其所處的歷史語境。本課程全程以英文授課。
